messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads-up: planning a schema change for user_profiles to add `last_login_v2` (nullable). Targeting Tue 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC for the deploy window. Plan is additive schema + dual-write for ~1h, then backfill over a few hours. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?

Jared Kim: I can own the deploy and DB runbooks. Confirming DB is RDS-postgres-prod and replicas are streaming. I'll prepare rollback scripts.

Maya Chen: Quick notes from infra side: avoid any full-table locks. If we need an index, use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` and run it before enabling heavy reads. Dual-write in-app is safest for 1h then read flip.

Samir Patel: Backfill strategy: run batched updates with LIMIT + sleep to avoid IO spikes. Estimate rows to backfill: `SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE last_login IS NOT NULL AND last_login_v2 IS NULL;` Share the count and we can estimate hours.

Priya Kapoor: Proposed step-by-step:
1) Deploy app change that writes to both `last_login` and `last_login_v2` behind a feature flag (flag OFF).
2) Run `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` if needed.
3) Turn on dual-write flag for 1 hour while we monitor error rates and p95 latency.
4) Launch backfill job (rate-limited batches) and monitor DB replication lag.
5) After verification, flip reads to `last_login_v2` and keep old column for 30 days before drop.

Jared Kim: Sounds good. Smoke checks I'll run after step 3: sample user update + GET. Example curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/users/123/login` then `curl /v1/users/123` check `last_login_v2`. I'll be available 02:00–04:00 UTC for first responder. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: Backfill example (k8s job):
```
while true; do
  psql -c "WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM user_profiles WHERE last_login IS NOT NULL AND last_login_v2 IS NULL LIMIT 1000) UPDATE user_profiles SET last_login_v2 = last_login FROM c WHERE user_profiles.id = c.id;"
  sleep 5
done
```
Rate-limit and watch replication lag.

Samir Patel: Also: set prom alert if replica_lag > 30s or CPU > 75% on writer during backfill. We should gate backfill on those signals.

Priya Kapoor: Rollback plan: flip flag OFF => stop writing to v2 and reads stay on old column. Rollback DB changes are additive (we won't DROP anything during window). If we see problems we'll abort backfill and revert flag.

Jared Kim: I'll prepare these artifacts before EOD: migration SQL, backfill job yaml, smoke-check script, and rollback commands. Need infra team signoff for running `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` (might need increased statement timeout).

Priya Kapoor: @Jared please also add an entry in the runbook with exact metrics to check (p95 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%, replica lag < 10s).

Jared Kim: Will do.

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job created: `migration-runner/job-1710651234-db-user_profiles-last_login_v2` for 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/1710651234 (created by @Jared Kim).

Priya Kapoor: Can someone sanity-check the dual-write window length? I put 1h but open to shorten if risk looks low.

Maya Chen: 1h is fine for observation. If backfill is slow we can extend, but keep backfill throttled. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: OK from my side. I'll run a quick count and post numbers by EOD so we can estimate backfill duration.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks team — I'll update the release ticket and tag oncall. I'll post the runbook link here once Jared uploads artifacts.

Jared Kim: Uploaded runbook + scripts to the ticket: https://go.redwood.dev/tickets/RI-4823. Ping me if you want a dry-run earlier.

Priya Kapoor: Great, thanks everyone.
